summary_en: Minimum 4,968,300 shares (29.9% of S/O ex-treasury) at ¥1,650/share. Tender period Aug 6 – Sep 17, 2026 (30 business days). No upper limit disclosed. Offeror SK-03 K.K. (100% held by SK-02 K.K.) intends to make CE Holdings a wholly owned subsidiary and delist it. Board supports the offer but takes neutral stance on shareholder tendering decisions. Parallel acquisition from CEO Sugimoto of 1,450,800 restricted shares (8.70% S/O) at settlement subject to minimum threshold achievement.
title_en: Notice regarding CE Holdings' support for and neutral position on SK-03 K.K.'s tender offer for the company's shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, CE Holdings' board approved a statement supporting an all-cash tender offer by SK-03 K.K. (a newly formed vehicle 100% owned by SK-02 K.K.) to acquire the company's ordinary shares at ¥1,650 per share. The tender period runs 30 business days from 6 August to 17 September 2026. The offeror has set a minimum acceptance threshold of 4,968,300 shares (29.9% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) with no stated upper limit. Achievement of this minimum would give SK-03 a 58.21% stake post-tender (including restricted shares held by directors that are excluded from the offer, adjusted for special-relationship rules). Upon closing, SK-03 intends to conduct a parallel acquisition of 1,450,800 restricted shares (8.70% S/O) from CEO Shigimoto, bringing total ownership to 66.91%, with the purpose of making CE Holdings wholly owned and delisting it from the Tokyo Standard. The board supports the transaction but expressly takes a neutral stance on whether shareholders should tender, leaving the decision to individual shareholders. Further restructuring steps, including a share consolidation, are contemplated for execution at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting following a successful tender.
